brief: Much of the evangelistic spreading of the gospel in the Pacific has been done by the Pacific peoples themselves. Under the leadership of the great European missionaries of both the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, the Christian message has been first accepted and then spread by the peoples of the Pacific. From Papua New Guinea to Tahiti, from Australia to Hawaii, from Micronesia to New Zealand, the good news has been proclaimed. Surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, we rejoice in their memory and pray that we will follow their examples.
